issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation omits the specific verb 'σκηνουντας' (dwelling/tabernacling). The Greek describes those who are 'dwelling in heaven' (σκηνουντας), whereas the Vietnamese simply says 'những kẻ ở trên trời' (those in heaven), losing the specific nuance of 'dwelling' or 'tabernacling' which is structurally linked to 'σκηνην' (tent/tabernacle).
